svg.title: Two MCP servers and what each one reaches
svg.desc: Your AI client connects to aeo-research, which has 12 tools, needs no sign-in and reaches Perplexity with your own key and the site you name. It also connects to aeo-toolkit, which has 40 tools, needs an AEO Toolkit account and reaches Search Console, GA4, Bing, the workspace AI engines and the IndexNow and Bing submission endpoints.
svg.text: These two act on services. The rest read or save to your dashboard.
